definitions.gloss: powdered milk; baby formula; infant formula
definitions.explanation: Dried milk in powder form. Most commonly refers to infant formula used as a substitute for or supplement to breast milk.

examples.japanese: {粉|こな}ミルクをお{湯|ゆ}で{溶|と}かす。
examples.english: Dissolve the powdered milk in hot water.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんに{粉|こな}ミルクを{飲|の}ませた。
{母乳|ぼにゅう}が{足|た}りないときは、{粉|こな}ミルクで{補|おぎな}うことがある。
examples.english: When there isn't enough breast milk, formula is sometimes used to supplement.

notes:
While {粉|こな}ミルク literally means 'powdered milk,' in everyday usage it almost always refers to infant formula. For powdered milk used in cooking or coffee, {脱脂粉乳|だっしふんにゅう} (skim milk powder) or スキムミルク is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉|こな}ミルクを{溶|と}かす: to dissolve formula
- {粉|こな}ミルクを{飲|の}ませる: to feed formula
- {粉|こな}ミルク{育児|いくじ}: formula feeding
- {粉|こな}ミルクを{作|つく}る: to prepare formula

RELATED TERMS:
- {母乳|ぼにゅう}: breast milk
- {哺乳瓶|ほにゅうびん}: baby bottle
- {液体|えきたい}ミルク: liquid formula (a newer product in Japan)
- {練乳|れんにゅう}: condensed milk — a different product entirely
